name: mop_ground
text: A person mops the floor with a long mop held in both hands, left hand at chest height and right hand low beside the right hip. Both elbows point down. Keep the mop head on the floor and make short forward and backward strokes, feet planted.

scene.description: Start at level ground facing +Z. A person mops the floor with a long mop held in both hands, left hand at chest height and right hand low beside the right hip. Keep the held object outside the torso and legs, and keep fingers and forearms on the intended grasp side.
